NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | Commit message must follow the commit style guidelines. The new subject is `web:suppress redundant nav tooltips on dm recipients_row and topic`. It has no space after `web:`, the summary isn't capitalized, it has no ending period, and there is no body explaining why. |
| ✅  | Explain how this PR relates to the other open PR for the issue. The author answered, saying the two are unrelated. |
| ℹ️  | The commit message was edited, but the only visible change is a shorter subject, which also dropped the space after the colon. This is the second round on the same request. |
| ℹ️  | The competing PR #40027 is still open for the same issue. CI status is unknown. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask for a commit message that follows the guide.

###### Reply

```quote
@adityas27, not yet: the commit message still doesn't follow the [commit message guidelines](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/version-control.html#commit-messages). Please compare it line by line with the examples there, covering the `web: ` prefix format, capitalization, ending the summary with a period, and adding a body that explains why.
```
